routeHint: Sign in as a member of Northwind Professional Association (slug t187c) and stay on the landing route; it is the dashboard (router.js name 'Dashboard', path '/'). Do not use /dashboard, which is the legacy DashboardOld view. This is the documentation home page hero, so the feed must show coherent recent posts and no full-bleed photo post: a single post with an attached image fills the bottom 40 percent of the frame with stock art. Suggested Groups renders 'Members' with no number because /groups never returns membersCount; that is a product gap, not a seeding one.
alt: The Orgo member dashboard: welcome banner and discussion feed in the centre, group and committee navigation on the left, and voting, events, tasks and suggested-group widgets on the right
